summary: Preserve shifted PCM tails when reconstructing quantized MP4 audio clocks
before: Initial exact-clock regression: sample/seek/video control passes and duration acceptance fails in 16 signed-CTS cases, reporting 60ms instead of 50/70ms. After fixing that getter, the expanded 1001Hz regression still fails both duration and PCM acceptance. pcm-1001-shift10-known.mp4 yields 1600 PCM bytes rather than 1920: 80 authored 8kHz samples are clipped by the recovered clock decode-duration endpoint. Both intermediate stages are retained.
after: 62 distinct integration checks pass: 61 in ten related targets plus one added worker regression (two focused checks overlap and are not counted twice). All 38 own PCM/ALAC+VP9 movies retain independent PCM byte counts/values, exact rational timestamps, seek suffixes, rewind, EOF, and all three video pictures. The worker plays and rewinds both shifted 1001Hz PCM/ALAC cases with the full 1920-byte waveform. Locked/offline no-default-features core build passes.
tests_run: cargo test --locked --offline --no-default-features --features player --test mp4_audio_presentation_end (baseline and staged/final checks)

cargo test --locked --offline --no-default-features --features player --no-fail-fast --test mp4_audio_presentation_end --test mp4_audio_clocks --test mp4_quantized_audio_clock --test mp4_variable_rate_edits --test mp4_audio_reconfiguration --test mp4_audio_export_transitions --test mp4_fixed_audio_edits --test mp4_open_ended_edit_audio --test mp4_unused_audio_descriptions --test owned_mp4_audio
limitations: The raw unedited index endpoint is nominal for ordinary codecs; existing explicit edits and recovered clocks remain authoritative.
Physical audio hardware, GPU parity and whole-project green are not claimed. Actual playback qualification uses the native worker with the existing captured backend.
